exposure.needed: whether monitoring dashboards, alerts or recording rules query the metric cilium_ces_sync_errors_total

decision.reason: [ev-36f95ff2158c] only lists `cilium_ces_sync_errors_total` under "Removed Metrics" in the 1.16 upgrade notes. It names no Helm value, flag or resource that controls the metric. An environment is exposed only if something outside Cilium's configuration consumes the metric, such as dashboards, alerts or recording rules. Cilium's configuration predicates cannot see those consumers, so the undecidable leaf that names this need is acceptable. Confidence is low because some alert rules could live in in-cluster resources that a predicate could read.
